ko: 주는 너의 큰 상급 큰 도움이시라
en: Praise the Lord in all circumstances of your life For He ‘s your great reward, the strong help in trouble

ko: 주의 얼굴 구할 때 주의 영을 부으사
크신 사랑 안에서 주를 보게 하소서
en: Lord, pour Your Spirit on us as we seek Your face That we might be able to see You in Your love
Lord, my heart is steadfast, I will sing praises with my soul By faith I lift up my eyes and see You in Your love

ko: 주를 찬양할 때 주의 나라 이미 임했네
주의 영원한 나라 주 보게 하소서
en: The Lord is enthroned upon the praises of His people I long to see, my Lord, Your eternal kingdom
Lord, my heart is steadfast, I will sing praises with my soul By faith I lift up my eyes and see You in Your love
